units.source_text: 明石女御与紫夫人共乘一车。

en.t: The Akashi Consort rode in the same carriage as Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 第二辆车子乃明石夫人所乘，尼姑老太太偷偷地跟了上去。

en.t: The second carriage was for the Lady of Akashi, and the old nun secretly followed along.

units.source_text: 女御的乳母知悉内情，所以也乘在这车中。

en.t: The Consort's nurse knew the circumstances, so she rode in that carriage too.

units.source_text: 供给诸女眷的侍女用的车子，紫夫人五辆，明石女御五辆，明石夫人三辆，

en.t: As for the carriages provided for the attendants of the ladies, Lady Murasaki had five, the Akashi Consort had five, and the Lady of Akashi had three,

units.source_text: 都装饰得华丽炫目，不必细说。

en.t: and all of them were decorated so splendidly and dazzlingly that there is no need to describe them in detail.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“反正大家要去，替师姑老太太好好打扮一下，

en.t: Genji said, "Since everyone is going anyway, dress the old nun up properly,

units.source_text: 把脸上的皱纹摸摸平，请她一同去吧。”

en.t: smooth out the wrinkles on her face a little, and let her come with us."

units.source_text: 明石夫人曾经劝阻，她说：“此次进香，规模如此盛大，

en.t: The Lady of Akashi had tried to stop it, saying, "This pilgrimage is being held on such a grand scale,

units.source_text: 老尼姑夹在里头，很不雅观。

en.t: and it would look quite unseemly for an old nun to be mixed in among them.

units.source_text: 如果她能活到大愿成遂之时，再请她参与吧。”

en.t: If she lives until the great vow is fulfilled, let her take part then."

units.source_text: 但老尼姑一则生怕余命无多，二则很想见识见识，一定要去，

en.t: But the old nun feared that she had little time left, and she also very much wanted to see it for herself, so she insisted on going,
and the Lady of Akashi finally agreed.

units.source_text: 这老尼姑前世积德，获得善报，

en.t: This old nun must have accumulated virtue in a previous life and received a blessed reward,

units.source_text: 比较起命里注定应享荣华富贵的人来，更加幸福，令人艳羡。

en.t: for she was even happier and more enviable than people fated to enjoy glory, wealth, and rank.
